basics.name: Jake Dickinson
basics.label: B.S. in Computer Science
basics.summary: I'm a computer science graduate who builds and deploys full-stack web applications. I enjoy turning complex problems into practical tools, from intuitive interfaces to reliable backend systems.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

highlights: Rebuilt cockpit UI with separate simulation, shared state, input, and rendering layers to keep panels synchronized and prevent direct input-driven changes to game state.
Converted static buttons into more than 10 interactive cockpit panels covering navigation, combat, engineering, strategic, and security systems for a recreation of Star Fleet II Deluxe.
Implemented shields, hyperspace travel, boarding, surrender, and interrogation mechanics based on the game manual, with behavioral tests and a headless rendering harness.

projects.name: Pineapple-Spire Financial Modeling Portal
projects.stack: TypeScript, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Vercel
highlights: Worked with a local firm on an eight-person team to turn layered Excel financial models into a web portal, matching calculations to the cent against the original spreadsheets.
Led versioned stress testing: designed schemas, built Prisma-backed API endpoints, and created an interface for saving and reloading models, with memoization to keep projections responsive.

projects.name: Da Club
projects.context: Club discovery portal for UH Mānoa
projects.stack: Next.js, React, Prisma, GitHub Actions, Playwright
highlights: Built search APIs for clubs by title and interests across a database of more than 100 organizations, and wrote a Python script to turn university spreadsheet data into JSON for ingestion.
Set up GitHub Actions to run Playwright tests on merges to main, and contributed role-based access logic and shared React components.

projects.name: Identifying Influential Users
highlights: Used graph traversal and dynamic filtering to identify influential users in social network data, with visualizations of centrality and community structure.

projects.name: Flower of Hope
highlights: Built object interaction, physics, and scene transitions in Unity, refining level design and game feel through playtesting.
